name: Piezo buzzer 12 mm
source: Typical 12 mm x 9.5 mm PCB-mount buzzer datasheet (pins 7.6 mm apart); not yet measured
notes: The firmware drives it with tone(), so it should be a passive piezo; an active buzzer (sealed bottom, sticker on top) only beeps at one pitch. The + pin is usually the longer leg and marked on top.
